notes: Evidence: scripts/verify-vendored-tokscale.js TOKEN_CONTRACT_CASES (client 'muse'). Fixture session at ~/.local/share/muse/sessions/<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/<sessionId>/session.jsonl; root taken from src/shared/clientSources.js (xdgData muse/sessions). Raw usage is inclusive on both axes: input_tokens 26964 includes cached_tokens/cache_read_tokens 5105, and output_tokens 379 includes reasoning_tokens 278. The two declared adjustments reproduce tokscale's contract row exactly (input 21859, output 101, cacheRead 5105, reasoning 278), and reasoningAdditive=true (muse is in TOKSCALE_DISJOINT_REASONING_CLIENTS, src/shared/history.js) reproduces the contract period total 27343 = 21859 + 101 + 0 (cacheWrite) + 5105 + 278. recorded_at in the fixture is 1789790455896395, i.e. microsecond epoch, hence timestamp unit 'us'. The raw usage object carries no total field, so fields.total is null and the localUsage-v1 fallback simply never fires.
